name: @op1/goals
description: Goal tracking plugin for OpenCode with slash commands, model tools, and guarded continuation

scripts.build: bun build src/index.tsx --outfile dist/goals.js --target bun --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/plugin/tui --external @opentui/solid --external solid-js --external zod && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --declarationMap false --outDir dist
